text:
rachel.marketing: quick flag from last webinar  big spike in manual claims. looks related to enrichment timing + RR handoff.
jamal.ops: can you share a concrete example? is this HubSpot->SFDC vs direct RR? :thinking_face: 
rachel.marketing: hubspot -> our router -> RR. When external enrichment takes >7s router TTL=5s moves to fallback queue; SDRs only watch RR so leads sit ~20-45m. saw ~1.6% of leads affected.
mike.salesops: suggestion: small change in HS workflows to set `defer_for_enrich=true` and route to a short-lived HoldQueue. Router should prefer HoldQueue before moving to Fallback. keeps RR clean.
jamal.ops: alternate: router checks enrichment service sync status on webhook receipt. if svc returns 202+progress header, bump TTL by 10s instead of immediate fallback. less churn in HS.
olivia.eng: engineering ops note: both are doable. fast path: add HoldQueue consumer to routing-service and a 30-60s recheck loop. safer: add enrich-probe header handling so router extends TTL when in-progress.
tony.sdr: from SDR side, prefer HoldQueue approach as long as these leads are hidden in the SDR inbox. accidental claims on partial records are costly. also add a digest for >15m holds.
mike.salesops: agreed. HS workflow change: set properties {"defer_for_enrich": "true", "owner": "unassigned"}. enrich webhook flips `enrich_state=done` and calls router re-submit endpoint. will test in sandbox.
jamal.ops: metrics checklist: hold_queue_depth, percent_held_over_30s, manual_claims_delta, enrich_probe_extend_count. add alarm if manual_claims_delta spikes >10% week-over-week.
olivia.eng: I'll open a small PR: 1) HoldQueue consumer with 45s max_hold, recheck every 5s; 2) feature flag `hold_for_enrich` so we can enable per-workflow; 3) Prometheus metrics and Grafana panel. aiming for canary in 24hrs.
mike.salesops: I'll update HS workflow and post instructions + XML fragment in #marketing when ready. SRD leads: please don't touch gateway-held leads until enrich_state=done or >15m.
lead-router-bot: routing-hold feature flagged (olivia.eng) 680 canary scheduled at 11:30 PT.
rachel.marketing: perfect. add playbook blurb: "If a lead has `defer_for_enrich=true` expect up to 45s delay before assignment; SDRs should wait for enrich_state=done. Digest delivered at top of hour."
jamal.ops: post-canary action: review dashboard and run backfill simulation on 1% synthetic load. plan rollback if manual_claims increase.
olivia.eng: noted. will include rollback toggle in the canary. thanks everyone.
